verdicts.confidence: High for default bindings, pure matcher/projection results and inspected routing/relay contracts; unresolved for full emit-site coverage and operational delivery impact.
verdicts.corrected_claim: ExecutorBindings has 26 default patterns. Listener matching uses topic and identity, not needs_attention or severity; options can override patterns. needs_attention is retained in projected wake metadata while severity is omitted. Eleven sampled topic shapes do not match defaults; two alternate pause-attention topics do, but the appended .resolved topic does not. Unbound topic membership does not establish that its underlying condition never reaches the Executor, since pause transitions can emit a bound attention topic. Skill text says 24 bindings, and the eight-alternative jq relay is a downstream filter. Workspace watch explicitly documents its central-alert exclusion and server-side backstop. The inherited 81/~50-topic and 57-emitter counts are not verified reachability measurements.
verdicts.method: Read frozen binding/listener/alert/projection/transition contracts and skill relay paths; execute actual Topic, ExecutorBindings and ExecutorWakeProjection modules in isolation for 14 topic samples and true/false metadata.
verdicts.note: Preserve a single explicit attention lifecycle policy, including resolution delivery and downstream consumption, rather than inferring a rewrite from grep counts. Routing only needs_attention=true would omit needs_attention=false resolution records and successful PR/CI control events. Current wiring gaps do not measure lost productive time, and package extraction is not required to repair a binding.
